name: Jim Dear
office: City of Carson, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Jim Dear is a Carson City Council member and a former Los Angeles Unified School District teacher. In his 2022 campaign, he said his top priorities were public safety, the health of residents, and economic development. In 2026, he opposed placing an oil refinery tax on the ballot and an updated pipeline franchise ordinance. As mayor, he says he helped bring national chains like Buffalo Wild Wings and Olive Garden to Carson. As city clerk in 2015, the City Council censured him after an investigation found he created a hostile work environment and made racist comments. Voters recalled him in 2016 for alleged misconduct, and he was elected to the City Council again in 2018.
